'''Kris Lavigne A little Bit of evrything v 2 0''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Kris Lavigne]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-5725">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5725 A little Bit of evrything v 2 0], DeckTech (Kris "VegasPimp" Lavigne, 20 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5725/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5725/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018181844/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5725/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Kris Lavigne]]
* '''Published:''' 20 April 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''A little Bit of evrything v 2 0''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Haven|CC-L-haven.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor HB Lavigne LS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck uses the Hidden base objective to activate massive amounts of force, then you drain in space while using the epp hit squad to cripple th opponent.

== Original post ==

'''A little Bit of evrything v 2 0'''
* '''Author:''' Kris "VegasPimp" Lavigne
* '''Published:''' April 20, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This deck uses the Hidden base objective to activate massive amounts of force, then you drain in space while using the epp hit squad to cripple th opponent.

=== Strategy ===

Changes I changed a few card in the deck from its last posting, i added Tantive 4, and removed endor, i decided to reduce the anount of systems as I try not to flip the objective anyway.  I also added two The signals to get out my much needed effects.

This deck is balanced space and ground. You grab dagobah and the hut first. This gives you good activation then you continue to pull systems. Your start of haven makes stuff deploy almost free, you then amaass your ships ata few systems using your spies to take out visage(if they have it)or to block drains. You use the eep squads for beatdown or do drain if they dont have much ground. You dont fip unless you are forced too. This deck wins almost all the time, only had troubl against an operative numbers deck because i didn't get ou the plant its farthest froma nd battle plan, it should win most games if played by a skilled player.
